notes.title: If My Heart Had Wings Simplified Chinese Out Now!
notes.content:
Hi All

[h1]We are really excited to announce that you can now play If My Heart Had Wings in Simplified Chinese![/h1]

We understand that many people may be a little worried about the quality of the Simplified Chinese translation. However, we can assure you that the text was translated from the original Japanese in order to preserve the essence. 
However, some of the Japanese jokes where a tad difficult to fully put across into Simplified Chinese and as per request of the original developers, has gained a literal translation in some areas. 
If you do not understand, please post in the forums, and we will be happy to offer a more detailed explanation! 

[u]Please note that the Simplified Chinese version cannot be purchased directly! You will need to buy the English version of If My Heart Had Wings and then get a free upgrade to the Simplfied Chinese version by downloading the DLC.[/u]

If you encounter any issues in upgrading to the Simplified Chinese version, please let us know in the forums, as we will be happy to help. We will be working to answer your questions as soon as possible. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7208711/aafae4ac0094dfc867d134e9ecfc4bdb726c0777.jpg[/img]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/734430/___If_My_Heart_Had_Wings__Simplified_Chinese/

[h1][b]Please note the following for installing the Simplified Chinese Edition of If My Heart Had Wings[/b][/h1]
[quote][h1]Precautions on using the Simplified Chinese Language Pack for If My Heart Had Wings[/h1]
This is the Simplified Chinese Language pack for If My Heart Had Wings, which must be applied to the original English version to convert it into the Simplified Chinese version of the game. Those who don't own the base English version will not be able to use this pack, so please buy the English version first.

[h1]Important Information[/h1]
Save files between the base English version and Simplified Chinese version of the games are not inter-compatible.
You will not be able to use save data from one version of the game with another. i.e. save data created on the base English version cannot be used on the Simplified Chinese version of the game or vice versa.

You can boot into the Simplified Chinese version of the game by selecting the Simplified Chinese Language Pack upon boot. When you boot the Simplified Chinese version of the game it will default to Simplified Chinese. You can change between Simplified Chinese and English from Config > System.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7208711/dc42605c6416a7ebbdcfca786fc0202275bad3b9.png[/img]

Conversely, you can boot into the base English version of the game by selecting the English Language Pack upon boot. The base English version of the game will not have options to switch languages (as it never included them). 

[h1]I installed the pack, but now my game won't boot?[/h1]
The Simplified Chinese version of the game requires a new version of Visual C++ Redistributables to be installed to function correctly. 

These are installed alongside the Simplified Chinese Language pack so you may be able to resolve the issue by uninstalling the Simplified Chinese Language Pack and base game, and then reinstalling them.[/quote]


We hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: Introducing Korona Kusakabe from A Sky Full of Stars
notes.content:
Today we are introducing the last of the playable routes for A Sky Full of Stars! 

Make sure you didn't miss the other introductions:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/745960/announcements/detail/1453964470342318079]Meet Hikari Houkiboshi[/url]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/745960/announcements/detail/1464097650383017995]Meet Saya Amanogawa[/url]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/745960/announcements/detail/1464097650383019543]Meet Orihime Shiratori[/url]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31216483/644c7614b570627aa317870b0ebe866747ef4f58.jpg[/img]

A Sky Full of Stars has a varied cast, with a lot of interactions and background stories tied together under the stars. Today we will be meeting the last of the four main heroines in the story; Korona Kusakabe. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31216483/85aaf430583bb1cd115c11af7428c6ec8751ab32.jpg[/img]

[h1]★ Korona Kusakabe[/h1]
va: Yuka Kotorii	
	
[list][quote][i]"Little Devil with a Crush!"[/i][/quote][/list]
	
Height: 153cm
B/W/H: 78/56/83
Birthday: September 3
Sign: Virgo
Blood type: AB
	
One year younger than Akito and the others, nothing quite seems to go her way.	
She thought Hikari was nice and had a crush on Akito.	
She wanted to be a part of their group, but she was too young.	
Then she watched as Saya immediately became close to them and that didn't sit right.	
That, on top of everything else, made her hate the fact that she was a year younger all the more.	
	
She loved Akito and tried desperately to get his attention, but as she was still a child with no sense of how to act properly, it made her act a little devilish.	
Her personality is a bit cat-like and contrary, but once she decides she likes you, she showers you with affection.	
	
That said, things rarely go her way.	
For example, should she spot Akito and run over to greet him, calling, "Heyyy, Akkyyy!", that's exactly the moment she'll fall out of sight in a ditch and end up crying when he doesn't find her.	
(true story)	
	
[list][quote][i]"Yep. So don't get any ideas about making moves on him, got it?"[/i][/quote][/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/745960/A_Sky_Full_of_Stars/

Check out our other updates sharing sneak peeks of the game: http://steamcommunity.com/app/745960/allnews/


[h1]#ProjectStarlight ends this week![/h1]
Share our excitement for the stars this winter by tweeting either your pictures of the stars or a special story about the stars using #ProjectStarlight. 
We will be selecting 10 people from these tweets and giving away 10 copies of the game! 
Let's turn the lights down and turn our eyes up to the glittering stars above! 
But hurry, as the campaign will be ending [b]THIS WEEK![/b] Enter before December 14th to be included in the contest! 
[url=https://twitter.com/Moenovel/status/931468656206163970]Check out the Tweet for more information[/url]

Blood type: AB
	
One year younger than Akito and the others, nothing quite seems to go her way.	
She thought Hikari was nice and had a crush on Akito.	
She wanted to be a part of their group, but she was too young.	
Then she watched as Saya immediately became close to them and that didn't sit right.	
That, on top of everything else, made her hate the fact that she was a year younger all the more.	
	
She loved Akito and tried desperately to get his attention, but as she was still a child with no sense of how to act properly, it made her act a little devilish.	
Her personality is a bit cat-like and contrary, but once she decides she likes you, she showers you with affection.	
	
That said, things rarely go her way.	
For example, should she spot Akito and run over to greet him, calling, "Heyyy, Akkyyy!", that's exactly the moment she'll fall out of sight in a ditch and end up crying when he doesn't find her.	
(true story)	
	
[list][quote][i]"Yep. So don't get any ideas about making moves on him, got it?"[/i][/quote][/list]
